steps.template_en: A module over a ring R is like a vector space over a field — scalars from a RING. Key: not every module has a basis (free modules do). Over a PID, finitely generated modules ≈ free part ⊕ torsion part.
steps.template_zh: 环R上的模就像域上的向量空间——标量来自环。关键：不是每个模有基(自由模有)。在PID上，有限生成模≈自由部分⊕挠部分。

steps.template_en: ℤ-modules = abelian groups. The module ℤ⊕ℤ₂: ℤ is free (rank 1), ℤ₂ torsion (2·1=0). Structure theorem: every f.g. abelian group G ≈ ℤʳ⊕ℤ_{n₁}⊕...⊕ℤ_{nₖ}.
steps.template_zh: ℤ-模=阿贝尔群。模ℤ⊕ℤ₂：ℤ自由(秩1)，ℤ₂挠(2·1=0)。结构定理：有限生成阿贝尔群G≈ℤʳ⊕ℤ_{n₁}⊕...⊕ℤ_{nₖ}。

steps.template_en: For F[x]-modules: a vector space V with linear operator T is an F[x]-module where x·v=T(v). The structure theorem gives the RATIONAL CANONICAL FORM of T. Torsion = companion matrix blocks of invariant factors.
steps.template_zh: 对F[x]-模：带线性算子T的向量空间V是F[x]-模，x·v=T(v)。结构定理给出T的有理标准型。挠=不变因子的友矩阵块。

steps.template_en: Structure Theorem: M ≅ Rʳ ⊕ R/(p₁^{e₁})⊕...⊕R/(pₖ^{eₖ}) where pᵢ are primes. Primary decomposition UNIQUE. Invariant factors: Rʳ ⊕ R/(d₁)⊕...⊕R/(dₘ) where d₁|d₂|...|dₘ.
steps.template_zh: 结构定理：M≅Rʳ⊕R/(p₁^{e₁})⊕...⊕R/(pₖ^{eₖ})，pᵢ为素元。准素分解唯一。不变因子：Rʳ⊕R/(d₁)⊕...⊕R/(dₘ)，d₁|d₂|...|dₘ。

steps.template_en: Classify: (1) All abelian groups of order 72. (2) ℤ-module ℤ₁₀⊕ℤ₁₅ — find invariant factors. (3) ℝ[x]-module for T with matrix [[2,0,0],[0,2,1],[0,0,2]]. (4) Show ℚ is NOT a finitely generated ℤ-module.
steps.template_zh: 分类：(1)72阶阿贝尔群。(2)ℤ-模ℤ₁₀⊕ℤ₁₅—找不变因子。(3)T的ℝ[x]-模，矩阵[[2,0,0],[0,2,1],[0,0,2]]。(4)ℚ不是有限生成ℤ-模。

steps.template_en: Modules over a PID unify two theories: (1) Finitely generated abelian groups (ℤ-modules). (2) Linear operators (F[x]-modules). The SAME theorem gives both the fundamental theorem of abelian groups AND canonical forms.
steps.template_zh: PID上模统一了两个理论：(1)有限生成阿贝尔群(ℤ-模)。(2)线性算子(F[x]-模)。相同定理给出阿贝尔群基本定理和标准型。
